title: Web server OOM kill without restart
reason: Engineer correctly identified the web container and OOM crash but did not name the memory‑spike trigger.
option_titles: Restart web and raise its memory limit to 512 MiB
root_cause: The web container (nginx:1.27) exited with code 137 (SIGKILL) 5 minutes ago, consistent with an out-of-memory kill of a process limited to 256 MiB. No recent changes to the web image occurred; the container ran for days before this sudden crash.
truth: The web container was killed by the OOM killer due to a temporary memory spike, and because it has no restart policy, it remained stopped.
